beats: Hook: prefill is a sprint, decode is a marathon: why make them share one running track? (line_pd_runner_pair as the cover, line_pd_shared_track).

The stall (slide 10): prefill-first scheduling lets one long prompt freeze everyone's next token for up to seconds; her words: smooth at first, then 'it stopped responding' (line_chunk_order_stall, line_scroll_reader).
Profiling (slide 11): decode alone leaves the GPU underused, one prefill of a few hundred tokens already fills it; so mix them and decode rides along (line_serve_order_glance from L13-01).

Chunked prefill (Sarathi-Serve, OSDI 2024; DeepSpeed-FastGen at the same time; slides 11-12): cut the long prompt into chunks; each iteration = all decode steps + chunks up to a token budget (e.g. 512 on an A100) (line_scissors_strips, line_chunk_belt_even).
Even iterations help pipeline parallelism (slide 12): uneven batches leave the next stage idle (bubbles), equal ones keep both busy (line_chunk_belt_uneven vs line_chunk_belt_even).
The trade-off (slide 13): small chunks protect the time between tokens but stretch the first token; big chunks fall back to the old stall (line_balance).

Disaggregation (DistServe OSDI 2024, Splitwise ISCA 2024; slide 14): prefill and decode on different GPUs, no interference; the KV cache is handed over like a baton (line_pd_two_venues, line_pd_baton_parcels).

Each side wants its own setup (slide 15): prefill likes tensor parallelism, decode likes data and pipeline parallelism; even different GPU types (H100 for prefill, A100 for decode) (line_pd_two_shoes).
The worked example (slide 16, taped): TTFT 400 ms, TBT 40 ms: colocated 1.6 requests/s per GPU; 2 prefill + 1 decode GPUs: min(5.6 x 2, 10) / 3 = 3.3 requests/s per GPU (line_gpu).
Rate matching (slide 17): one prefill job per request, decode jobs = requests x output length; the workload's prompt/answer ratio sets the split.
Costs (slide 18): a fast network to move the KV cache; a long prompt with a very short answer moves a mountain for one note; per-layer transfer overlaps it (line_pd_big_move_small_note).
Takeaway (slide 18): one GPU or small scale: chunked prefill; strict SLOs and mixed hardware: disaggregation; vLLM and SGLang support both (line_pd_truck_vs_hall).
